head: countersunk (substitute, per forum)
notes: Rear storage compartment striker/frame screw. Only size hint is a CorvetteForum owner who replaced missing 9426552 screws with 'the shortest csk 832' from a hardware store: a substitute, not an official size, so low. Length unknown. Searched: 'GM 9426552'; '9426552 screw'; '9426552 corvette storage compartment striker screw'.
